description: Toegang bedrijven North Sea Port is a dataset listed in Open Data Portaal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by North Sea Port. Deze GIS laag geeft de toegangspoorten aan van de verschillende bedrijven binnen het North Sea Port gebied. Coverage: Ghent. The portal files it under Werken & ondernemen. Its keywords are Haven. The portal shows 570 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-11-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik (https://www.vlaanderen.be/digitaal-vlaanderen/onze-oplossingen/open-data/voorwaarden-voor-het-hergebruik-van-overheidsinformatie/modellicentie-gratis-hergebruik). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stad-gent-portal.
